documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of Postal_Ballot
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Manorama Industries Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 results, achieving 39.5% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 404 crores and crossing the INR 4,000 million quarterly revenue and EBITDA milestone. Profitability grew by 67.6% year-on-year to INR 79 crores, driven by a richer product mix of value-added specialty fats, operating leverage, and expanded fractionation capacity. The company is advancing strategic expansion plans, including backward integration in West Africa via a new Chad subsidiary and a Burkina Faso processing facility, and upcoming solvent fractionation and refinery capacities in India. Management remains confident in long-term growth prospects, supported by a successful QIP and ongoing investments across its globally integrated specialty ingredients platform. Manorama Industries reported strong performance for Q1 FY27, achieving a quarterly revenue milestone exceeding INR 4,000 million and robust year-on-year growth in profitability supported by value-added specialty fats and upgraded fractionation capacity.

guidance.claim: The company expects capacity utilization to be around 80% to 85% for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: So we expect our to be around 80%, 85% for full year for this year.

guidance.claim: Management targets an overall capacity utilization of around 80% for the year.
guidance.quote: But for our stakeholders, we can take 80% and whatever improvement is there will be shown and will be shared to our stakeholders.

demand_outlook.claim: Profitability grew year-on-year, reflecting sustained demand across end-use industries and deeper customer relationships.
demand_outlook.quote: Our profitability grew by 67.6% year-on-year, reflecting sustained demand across the end use industries, deeper customer relationships and the increasing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Export to domestic revenue mix stood at 60:40 reflecting global customer strength and healthy domestic demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Our export to domestic revenue mix stood at 60:40 reflecting the continued strength of our global customer base alongside healthy domestic demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The pricing model for value-added products remains largely stable and in line with the costing model.
demand_outlook.quote: So our pricing model, if you say, has been -- remained stable largely, which is in line of our costing model as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that revenue growth was supported by sustained demand across key end-user industries and deeper customer engagement.
demand_outlook.quote: Profitability increased by 67.6% YoY, reflecting sustained demand across key end-user industries, deeper customer engagement, and the growing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired approximately 10 hectares of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, we acquired approximately 10 hectares, 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility with regulatory approvals currently in the progress.

capex_expansion.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to spend approximately INR 225 crores to INR 250 crores on capex in financial year 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So ballpark capex guidance for this year should be around INR 225 crores to INR 250-odd crores of investment in financial year approximately in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The Burkina Faso facility capex is estimated at around INR 120 crores to INR 130 crores out of the proposed capex plan.
capex_expansion.quote: So that Burkina Faso facility will be around INR120 crores, INR 130 odd crores approximately, and the balance should be for Indian projects out of INR 460 crores of our proposed capex plan.

capex_expansion.claim: Debottlenecking will add approximately 4,500 tons of capacity, taking total capacity from 47,500 tons to approximately 52,000 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: So approximately, we are expecting additional 4,500 tons of debottlenecking in this financial year, additionally. So our current capacity of 47,500 tons will be going to around approximately to around 52,000 tons per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Manorama Savannah Agro Chad SARL, in the Republic of Chad to strengthen its Shea sourcing network.
capex_expansion.quote: To strengthen its Shea sourcing network in West Africa, the Company incorporated Manorama Savannah Agro Chad SARL, a wholly owned subsidiary in Chad.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans a strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years.
capex_expansion.quote: Through strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years, this investment program spans setting up of a new solvent fractionation manufacturing facility for Sal, Shea, Palm, Mango and other exotic seeds and ESOS.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax margin expanded by 326 basis points to 19.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 67.6% year-on-year, that is INR 79 crores with profit after tax margin expanding by 326 basis points to 19.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost run rate going forward is expected to be around INR 14 crores to INR 15 crores per quarter.
margins_costs.quote: But currently, the run rate, which we can take should be around INR 14 crores to INR 15 crores per quarter going forward. It should be generally in this line only.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in other expenses was primarily due to higher freight and container costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, that is right. It is primarily because of that only.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin broadly moves in the range of 45% to 50%.
margins_costs.quote: And our gross margin broadly moves in the range of that range only of around 45% to 50%, what we can say because a lot of time, it depends on freight cost timing also and our by-product realization, which is a de-oiled cake.

margins_costs.claim: Stand-alone EBITDA was INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%, reflecting focused product mix optimization and disciplined cost management.

orders_capacity.claim: A portion of additional fractionation capacity of 7,500 has already been operationalized, with the balance intended around Quarter 3 of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: So we already have done a portion of our additional capacity of 7,500, which is already have been operationalized. And the balance is intended to be implemented in a manner during FY27 around Quarter 3 of this financial year, subject to operational time lines.

orders_capacity.claim: Fractionation capacity stands at 47,500 MTPA including 25,000 MTPA commercialized in July 2025 and 7,500 MTPA via debottlenecking in March 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Fractionation Capacity 47,500 MTPA (Includes 25,000 MTPA commercialized in July 2025, plus 7,500 MTPA via debottlenecking in Mar 2026)

capital_allocation.claim: The QIP strengthened the balance sheet and provided financial flexibility to accelerate growth.
capital_allocation.quote: The successful completion of our qualified institutional placement, QIP, marks another important milestone, strengthening our balance sheet and providing the financial flexibility to accelerate growth across manufacturing, sourcing and high value-added segments.

capital_allocation.claim: Total capex spent until the date of the call was around INR 70 crores out of the total proposed capex plan.
capital_allocation.quote: Until today, we have spent around INR 70 crores out of our total proposed capex plan, and we intend to spend approximately around INR 220 odd crores more in this financial year for our capex.

capital_allocation.claim: The net debt and equity ratio stood at 0.38:1 as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt and equity ratio is 0.38:1 as of 31st March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that temporary bans by countries do not materially impact sourcing strategy due to a vast presence in Africa.
risks_headwinds.quote: So that is one country which has put a temporary ban. So that doesn't materially impact our sourcing strategy from there because our presence in that geography area is vast, which is substantial in Africa region.

management_commitments.claim: The balance debottlenecking capacity is intended to be implemented during FY27 around Quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: And the balance is intended to be implemented in a manner during FY27 around Quarter 3 of this financial year, subject to operational time lines.

management_commitments.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to spend approximately INR 220 crores more in financial year 2027 for capex.
management_commitments.quote: Until today, we have spent around INR 70 crores out of our total proposed capex plan, and we intend to spend approximately around INR 220 odd crores more in this financial year for our capex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
